sources.evidence: Official API changelog dates the Grok 4.20 launch March 10, 2026. It does not date public availability March 9 or equate the 0309 identifier suffix with a release day.

sources.title: Grok 4.20 System Card, April 7, 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh HTTP 200 complete eight-page original card read. Section 1 explicitly calls single-agent and multi-agent deployment modes Grok 4.2 SA/MA. Section 1.2 describes pretraining, targeted mid-training, supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning; it does not identify an unchanged named earlier base or disclose total/active parameters. Tables 1-4 contain safety/evaluation metrics, not parameter counts. It does not name the dated API checkpoint.

sources.evidence: Fresh HTTP 200 original accepted-manuscript PDF for the May 20, 2026 paper. Appendix Table 8, PDF page 43, lists xAI Grok 4.20 with a dash in the Parameters column and supplies no active/activated-parameter column. The 159.8 entry is tokens per second; energy estimates do not measure active parameters. This later original research comparison provides no count and does not supersede the founder total disclosure.

patch.description: Grok 4.20 reasoning API model with text and image inputs, text output, and function calling.
patch.notes: The 0309 identifier denotes the snapshot; xAI dates the API launch March 10, 2026. The founder disclosed nominal 500B total for Grok 4.20, whose reasoning mode is linked to the dated identifier by official documentation. This rounded model size is not a separate tensor census of the snapshot. Active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed. Native context is 1,000,000 tokens; provider limits can differ. PDF attachments use document search.

summary: Retain the founder-disclosed nominal 500B total after fresh original-source review, with explicit reasoning-mode linkage and total-versus-active scope. Active parameters remain undisclosed after separate searches, original/later xAI cards, a later original research comparison and named-lineage review. Preserve all twelve other assessments: March 10 native API release, proprietary classification, native text/image modalities, one-million-token context, reasoning, function calling and the corrected description. No weights or authenticated inference were fetched.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=500 verified (published nominal total); active_parameters_b=null undisclosed after a separate fresh review.
parameter_reaudit.total_assessment: Both founder replies were independently refetched and their embedded parent questions read. April 9 explicitly answers the total-versus-active question with 0.5T total. Preserve nominal 500B; no tensor-exact precision or host attestation is required. The native exact-model page and Oracle provider mode table establish the reasoning-mode mapping.
parameter_reaudit.active_assessment: No supported active/activated count found. The April 9 reply does not turn 500B total into active. Original safety tables and later xAI research cards have no active-count column. The later Scientific Reports original Table 8 lists the unqualified model with a dash for parameter scale and no active column; its throughput and modeled energy cannot be converted into a parameter count.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: Original Section 1.2 describes Grok 4.20 pretraining, mid-training, SFT and RL without identifying an unchanged named earlier base. The explicit reasoning/non-reasoning mode relationship supplies model identity but no independently known active size. Single-agent/multi-agent are deployment modes. Later 4.5/4.6/4.7 training and teacher-data relationships do not name a counted unchanged 4.20 ancestor; no sibling or unnamed teacher count is transferred.
parameter_reaudit.later_comparison_assessment: Independently searched all 29/42/30 pages of the fresh original 4.5/4.6/4.7 model-card cache and all nine pages of the June framework. No Grok 4.20 parameter disclosure. Freshly read Scientific Reports Table 8 on PDF page 43, including caption/notes; its dash is absence of a figure in that paper, not evidence against the direct founder total.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Bounded searches separately covered total, active/activated, exact dated identifier, later research comparisons and named lineage. Secondary search hits included incompatible 3T/500B-active or 6T claims and explicitly speculative active ranges; none supplied a developer disclosure or original measured active-count convention and none was adopted. API generation parameters, inference speed, agent counts and model size were kept distinct.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: All six direct agent fetches returned HTTP 200: native Markdown, both founder syndication payloads, original 4.20 PDF, Oracle page and original later comparison PDF. The web reader could not render native text/markdown, so direct HTTP content was read. Later xAI PDFs were independently read from the parent's documented October 27 HTTP 200 primary cache rather than claimed as agent refetches.
